summary: Deepgram for Startups grants up to $100,000 in API credits usable over 12 months across speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and Voice Agent APIs. Applicants must be an AI builder or early-stage startup, in production or launching within the next 6 months. Credits are deposited 24–48 hours after acceptance.
claim_steps: Create a Deepgram account at console.deepgram.com and have your Project ID handy.
Apply at deepgram.com/startup-program (review typically takes about a week).
On acceptance, credits are automatically deposited in your console within 24–48 hours.
